description: Axes and house cusps for every catalog house system under the true-equinox convention, at the earth-orientation-erfa.json epochs (inputs jd_ut/jd_tt are taken from that file). Each case records the RAMC and obliquity used.
provenance: Generated from tauri-application domain::houses (compute_axes_with + house_cusps_for_system_with) with sofars nut06a/ee06a nutation. Pins Rust/Python agreement; tests/test_house_definitions.py checks RAMC/obliquity against ERFA (GAST, true obliquity) and every cusp against its system's geometric definition.
